title: Android: CameraServer fails with "Expected Image data size" error on YUV_420_888 stream
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
- Godot Engine v4.5.stable.official.876b29033

I have not tested earlier or later versions. Given the nature of the bug, it appears to be a hardware-specific issue related to the handling of YUV camera streams, which may have been present in other versions as well.

### System information

OS: Android 13   -   Device: Oppo CPH2565   -   GPU: Qualcomm Adreno (TM) 610   -   Godot Version: v4.5.stable.official.876b29033   -   Rendering Backend: OpenGL ES 3.2 (Compatibility)

### Issue description

Activating the `CameraServer` on certain Android devices results in a **black screen** being displayed instead of the camera feed, while the debugger is **continuously spammed** with C++ errors.

This occurs on devices where the camera's only available output format is `YUV_420_888`. The errors (`Expected Image data size... got... bytes instead`) strongly indicate that Godot is not correctly handling memory stride/padding from the camera driver's raw YUV data stream.

The expected behavior is that the camera feed should be displayed correctly without errors.

**Error Log:**
```cpp
E 0:00:06:113   _texture_set_data: Condition "texture->format != p_image->get_format()" is true.
  <C++ Source>  drivers/gles3/storage/texture_storage.cpp:1551 @ _texture_set_data()
E 0:00:06:173   initialize_data: Expected Image data size of 2400x1080x1 (Red8 without mipmaps) = 2592000 bytes, got 2764640 bytes instead.
  <C++ Error>   Method/function failed.
  <C++ Source>  core/io/image.cpp:2227 @ initialize_data()
E 0:00:06:174   initialize_data: Expected Image data size of 1200x540x2 (RedGreen without mipmaps) = 1296000 bytes, got 1382239 bytes instead.
  <C++ Error>   Method/function failed.
  <C++ Source>  core/io/image.cpp:2227 @ initialize_data()
```
**Available Camera Formats (Logged from Device):**
```json
[{ "width": 2400, "height": 1080, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 1920, "height": 1080, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 1680, "height": 720, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 1612, "height": 720, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 1600, "height": 900, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 1600, "height": 720, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 1600, "height": 716, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 1520, "height": 720, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 1440, "height": 1080, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 1280, "height": 960, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 1280, "height": 768, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 1280, "height": 720, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 1080, "height": 1080, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 1024, "height": 768, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 960, "height": 960, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 960, "height": 720, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 800, "height": 600, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 800, "height": 480, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 800, "height": 400, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 720, "height": 720, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 720, "height": 480, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 640, "height": 480, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 640, "height": 400, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 640, "height": 360, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 352, "height": 288, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 320, "height": 240, "format": "YUV_420_888" }, { "width": 176, "height": 144, "format": "YUV_420_888" }]
```

### Steps to reproduce

1.  Use the attached Minimal Reproduction Project.
2.  Export and run the project on an affected Android device (details in System Info).
3.  The project will automatically attempt to activate the camera feed.
4.  Observe that the output is a permanent **black screen** instead of the camera feed.
5.  Check the Godot debugger or `logcat` to see the continuous stream of errors.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

- File: [godot-camerafeed-demo-main.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22437354/godot-camerafeed-demo-main.zip).

- [Link to the project on GitHub.](https://github.com/shiena/godot-camerafeed-demo)
